Hausa: A cikin watan Disamba na shekarar 2017, masu binciken sun yi hira da marasa lafiya guda 391 da aka yi musu jinya a asibitin Nekemte da yake gabashin Wollega, Habasha.
Northern Sotho: Ka Desemere 2017, banyakišiši ba botsološitše balwetši ba 391 bao ba bego ba alafša kasepetleleng sa Nekemte hospital ka bohlabela bja Wollega, Ethiopia.
Amharic: በዲሴምበር 2017 ተመራማሪዎቹ በኢትዮጵያ ምስራቅ ወለጋ በነቀምት ሆስፒታል ህክምና ሲደረግላቸው ለነበሩ 391 ታካሚዎች ቃለ መጠይቅ አድርገዋል፡፡

Source: This hospital is a referral hospital, meaning that they often deal with complex medical cases that have been referred to them by doctors or clinics.
Luganda: Eddwaliro lino lijulizibwamu abalwadde, ekitegeeza nti batera okujjanjaba endwadde enzibu ennyo eziba zibajuliziddwako okuyita mu basawo oba obulwaliro.
Yoruba: Ilé ìwòsàn yìí jẹ́ ilé ìwòsàn ìfiṣọwọ́, èyí túmọ̀ sí pé àwọn àìsàn tí ó pẹ̀ka tí àwọn dọ́kítà tàbí tí ilé ìtọ́jú fíṣọwọ́ sí wọn ní wọn máa ń wò.
Zulu: Lesi sibhedlela isibhedlela sokuthunyelwa, okusho ukuthi bajwayele ukwenza umsebenzi obucayi wokwelapha othunyelwe kubo ngodokotela noma imitholampilo.
Hausa: Wannan Asibiti na turawa ne, ma'ana sau da yawa suna fama da matsaloli masu rikitarwa waɗanda likitoci ko asibitoci suka kai musu.
Northern Sotho: Sepetlele se ke sepetlele ke fao balwetši ba romelwago gona, go rago gore gantši ba šoma ka malwetši ao a hlakahlakanego ao balwetši ba rometšwego go bona ke dingaka goba dikliniki.
Amharic: ይህ ሆስፒታል ሪፈራል ሆስፒታል ነው፤ ማለትም ብዙ ጊዜ ከዶክተሮች ወይም ከክሊኒኮች የተላኩ ውስብስብ የህክምና ጉዳዮችን ይመለከታል፡፡

Source: However, many outpatients come to the hospital without referrals.
Luganda: Wabula, abalwadde abakyaze bangi bagenda mu malwaliro amanene nga tebajuliziddwayo.
Yoruba: Wàyí, ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn aláìsàn alálọbọ̀ ní wọ́n máa ń wà sí ilé ìwòsàn yìí láìfi wọ́n ránṣẹ́ sí bẹ̀.
Zulu: Kodwa, iziguli eziningi ezingalaliswa ziza kulesi sibhedlela zingathunyelelwe.
Hausa: Duk da haka, yawancin marasa lafiya na zuwa asibiti ba tare da an tura su ba.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale, balwetši ba bantši ba ka ntle bat la sepetlele ka ntle le gop romelwa ke dingaka.
Amharic: ይሁን እንጂ ብዙ ተመላላሽ ታካሚዎች ወደ ሆስፒታሉ ያለ ምንም ሪፈራል ይመጣሉ፡፡

Source: The researchers therefore asked patients why they had chosen to use Nekemte hospital instead of other healthcare facilities.
Luganda: Noolwekyo abanoonyereza baabuuza abalwadde lwaki baasalawo okugenda mu Nakemte hospital okusinga amalwaliro amalala.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí bèrè lọ́wọ́ àwọn aláìsàn ìdí tí wọ́n yàn láti máa lo ilé ìwọ̀sàn Nekemte dípò àwọn ohun èlò ilé ìtọ́jú mìíràn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi ngakho-ke babuza iziguli ukuthi kungani bakhetha ukusebenzisa isibhedlela i-Nekemte esikhundleni sokusebenzisa ezinye izikhungu zezempilo.
Hausa: Don haka, masu binciken sun tambayi marasa lafiya dalilin da yasa suka zaɓi yin amfani da asibitin Nekemte maimakon sauran wuraren kiwon lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Ka fao banyakišiši ba ile ba botšiša balwetši gore ke ka lebaka la eng ba kgethile go šomiša sepetlele sa Nekembe sebakeng sa mafelo a mangwe a tša maphelo.
Amharic: ስለሆነም ተመራማሪዎቹ ታካሚዎቹን ከሌሎች የጤና ጥበቃ ተቋማት ይልቅ የነቀምት ሆስፒታልን ለመጠቀም ለምን እንደመረጡ ጠይቀዋል፡፡

Source: They included questions about how accessible healthcare facilities were, the quality of service they provided, the treatment options available, and how sick the patients felt when seeking treatment.
Luganda: Baateekamu n’ebibuuzo ebikwata ku busobozi bw’okutuuka ku malwaliro, omutindo gw’empeereza eriyo, ebika by’obujjanjabi eby’enjawulo ebiriyo, awamu n’engeri gye baali bawuliramu obulwadde nga banoonya obujjanjabi.
Yoruba: Wọ́n bẹ̀rè bí ó ṣe rọrùn fún wọn sí láti lo àwọn ohun èlò ilé ìtọ́jú, bí iṣẹ́ wọn ṣe dára to, àwọn àṣàyàn ìtójú tó wà, àti bí àìsàn ṣe mú àwọn aláìsàn sí nígbà tí wọ́n wá ìtọ́jú.
Zulu: Bafaka imibuzo ebuza ngokuthi bezitholakala kanjani izikhungu zezempilo, izinga lezinsiza ebelinikeza, indlela yokuthe ukwelasha okukhona, nano kuthi iziguli bezigula kangakanani uma zifuna ukwelashwa.
Hausa: Sun haɗa da tambayoyi game da yadda wuraren kiwon lafiya ke isa, ingancin aikin da suka bayar, zaɓuɓɓukan jiyya da ke akwai, da kuma yadda marasa lafiya suke ji yayin neman magani.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba akaretša dipotšišo tša mabapi le gore mafelo a tlhokomelo a maphelo a be a fihlelelega bjang, boleng bja ditirelo tšeo a di abago, dikgethgo tša kalafo tše di hwetvagalago, ler gore balwetši ba be ba ikwa bjang ge ba nyaka kalafoa.
Amharic: የጤና ጥበቃ መስጫ ተቋማት ምን ያህል ተደራሽ እንደሆኑ፤ ስለሰጡት አገልግሎት ጥራት፤ ስላሏቸው የህክምና አማራጮች እና ታካሚዎቹ ህክምና ፍለጋ ሲመጡ ምን ያህል ህመም እንደነበራቸው በጥያቄዎቻቸው አካተዋል፡፡

Source: They also asked patients how much they knew about how, and why, smaller health facilities refer patients to specialists at the hospital.
Luganda: Mu ngeri endala era baabuuza abalwadde kye bamanyi ku ngeri, n’ensonga lwaki malwaliro amatono gajuliza abalwadde eri abakugu mu malwaliro amanene.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún bèrè lọ́wọ́ àwọn aláìsàn iye ohun tí wọ́n mọ̀ nípà bí àtí ìdí tí àwọn ilé ìtọ́jú kéréje ṣẹ máa ń fi àwọn aláìsàn ránṣẹ́ sí àwọn akọ́ṣẹ́-mọṣẹ́ ẹ̀tò ìlẹra ní àwọn ilé ìwòsàn.
Zulu: Baphinde babuza iziguli ukuthi bebazi kangakanani ngokuthi kanjani, nokuthi ngoba yini, izikhungo zezempilo ezincane zithumelele iziguli kongoti esibhedlela.
Hausa: Sun kuma tambayi marasa lafiya nawa suka sani game da yadda, kuma me ya sa ƙananan cibiyoyin kiwon lafiya suke tura marasa lafiya zuwa ga ƙwararru a asibiti.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba botšiša gape balwetši gore ba be ba tseba kudu bjang mabapi le gore mafelo a maphelo a mannyane a romela balwetši go ditsebi ka sepetlele, le gore ke ka lebaka la eng ba dira se.
Amharic: ትንንሽ የጤና ተቋማት ወደ ሆስፒታሉ ስፔሻሊስቶች ታካሚዎችን እንዴት እና ለምን እንደሚልኩ ምን ያህል እንሚያውቁም ታካሚዎችን ጠይቀዋል፡፡

Source: They then analysed the patients’ answers to find out the most important reasons for patients using the hospital rather than local healthcare.
Luganda: N’oluvannyuma beekaliriza ebyanukulo by’abalwadde okusobola okuzuula ensonga ezisinga okuba enkulu eziviirako abalwadde okukozesa amalwaliro amanene okusinga obulwaliro bw’omu bitundu.
Yoruba: Nígbà náà ní wọ́n ṣe àgbéyẹ̀wò èsì àwọn aláìsàn láti ri ìdí tí ó ṣe pàtàkì jù lọ tí àwọn aláìsàn fi ń lo ilé ìwọ̀sàn dípò ilé ìtọ́jú abẹ́lé.
Zulu: Babe sebehlaziya izimpendulo zeziguli ukuthola izizathu ezibaluleke kakhulu zokuthi iziguli zisebenzise isibhedlela kunokusebenzisa imitholampilo yendawo.
Hausa: Sannan sun yi nazarin amsoshin marasa lafiya don gano dalilan da suka fi dacewa ga marasa lafiya da suke amfani da asibiti maimakon kula da lafiyar gida.
Northern Sotho: Go tloga fao ba ile ba sekaseka dikarabo tša balwetši go hwetša mabaka a bohlokwa kudu ao a dirago gore balwetši ba šomiše dipetlele go feta mafelo a tlhokomelo ya maphelo a kgauswi.
Amharic: ከዚያም ታካሚዎች ከአካባቢው የጤና ጥበቃ ይልቅ ሆስፒታሉን የሚጠቀሙበትን ዋነኛ ምክንያቶች ለማወቅ የታካሚዎቹን መልሶች ተንትነዋል፡፡

Source: What the researchers found was that 330 (84%) of the patients they interviewed had come to Nekemte hospital without referrals even though there were other healthcare options closer to home.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza kya bazuula kyali nti abalwadde 330 (84%) be babuuza baali bajja mu Nekemte hospital nga tebajuliziddwa kuva mu bulwaliro newankubadde nga waaliwo ebifo ebirala eby’enjawulo omufunibwa obujjanjabi ebiri okumpi ne gye babeera.
Yoruba: Ohun tí àwọn aṣèwádìí ri ni pé aláìsàn 330 (84%) tí wọ́n fọ́rọ̀ wá lẹ́nu wò ló wá sí ilé ìwòsàn Nekemete láìsí ẹni tí ó fí wọ́n ránṣẹ́ sí bẹ̀, bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé àwọn àṣàyàn ilé ìtọ́jú wà tí ó súnmọ́ ilé.
Zulu: Abakutholile abacwaningi ukuthi ama-330 (84%) eziguli abazihlabe ngemibuzo bezize esibhedlela e-Nekemte ngaphandle kokuthunyelwa ngisho noma bezikhona ezinye izindlela zokuya kweminye imtholampilo esondelene nasekhaya.
Hausa: Abin da masu binciken suka gano shi ne, 330 (84%) na majinyatan da suka yi hira da su sun zo asibitin Nekemte ba tare da an turo su ba duk da cewa akwai wasu hanyoyin kiwon lafiya kusa da gida.
Northern Sotho: Seo banyakišiši ba se hweditšego ke gore 330 (84%) ya balwetši ba tlile sepetleleng sa Nekemte ka ntle le go romles le ge e le gore go na le dikgetho tše dingwe tša tlhokomelo ya maphelo tša kgauswi le gae.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንደደረሱበት ከሆነ ምንም እንኳ ለመኖሪያቸው የሚቀርቡ ሌሎች የጤና ጥበቃ አማራጮች ቢኖሩም ቃለ መጠይቅ ካደረጉላቸው ታካሚዎች ውስጥ 330 (84%) የሚሆኑት ያለ ምንም ሪፈራል ወደ ነቀምት ሆስፒታል መምጣታቸውን ነው፡፡

Source: Some of the most important reasons the patients gave included thinking their illness was very serious, difficulty in finding transport to closer facilities, believing the hospital had better healthcare staff, and thinking that the hospital provides better overall care and treatments.
Luganda: Ezimu ku nsonga enkulu abalwadde ze baawa mwalimu okulowooza nti obulwadde bwabwe bwali bwa maanyi nnyo, obuzibu bw’okufuna entambula okutuuka mu bulwaliro obuliraanye, okulowooza nti eddwaliro eryo eddene lyalina abasawo abalungi, awamu n’okulowooza nti eddwaliro lirina endabirira n’enzijanjaba esingako okutwaliza awamu.
Yoruba: Lára àwọn ìdí pàtàkì tí àwọn aláìsàn ń sọ ni pé àwọn rò pé àìsàn àwọn lágbára gidi, ìṣòro wíwá ọkọ̀ lọ sí àwọn ilé ìtọ́jú etílé, ìgbàgbọ́ pé ilé ìwòsàn ní àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ tó dáńgájíá, àti èrò pé ilé ìwòsàn máa ń pèsè ìtọ́jú tóyèpooro.
Zulu: Enye yezizathu ezibalulekile iziguli eziyinikezile ibifaka phakathi ukucabanga ukuthi ukugula kwakhe ilokhu okumgulisa kakhulu, ubunzima bokuthola izinto zokuthutha ezikuyisa emtholampilo eseduzane, ukukholelwa ukuthi isibhedlela sinabasebenzi abangcono, nokucabanga ukuthi isibhedlela isona esinikeza ukunakekelwa okuhle nokwelashwa.
Hausa: Wasu daga cikin muhimman dalilan da majinyatan suka bayar sun haɗa da tunanin rashin lafiyarsu na da matuƙar tsanani, wahalar samun abin hawa zuwa wuraren da suke kusa, da imani cewa asibitin na da ƙwararrun ma’aikatan kiwon lafiya, da kuma tunanin cewa asibitin na samar da ingantacciyar kulawa da jinya.
Northern Sotho: A mangwe a mabaka a bohloklwa kudu ao balwetši mafelelong ba a filego e bile gore ba be ba naba gore bolwetši bja bona bo kotsi, go swara bothata bja go hwetša senamelwa sa go ya mafelong a kgauswi, go dumela gore sepetlele se fana ka tlhokomelo le kalafo ye kaone ka kakaretšo.
Amharic: ታካሚዎቹ ካነሷቸው ዋና ዋና ምክንያቶች መካከል ጥቂቶቹ፣ ህመማቸው በጣም ከባድ እንደሆነ የማሰብ፤ ወደ ቅርብ ተቋማት መጓጓዣ የማግኘት ችግር፤ ሆስፒታሉ የተሻሉ የጤና ጥበቃ ሰራተኞች እንዳሉት ማመን እና ሆስፒታሉ የተሻለ ጠቅላላ እንክብካቤ እና ህክምናዎችን እንደሚሰጥ ማመንን ያካተቱ ነበሩ፡፡

Source: The researchers also noticed that patients who understood that smaller facilities like clinics could refer them to hospital if needed, were less likely to go straight to the hospital with health issues.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baakiraba nti abalwadde abaali bakimanyi nti amalwaliro amatono gamba ng’obulwaliro, gasobola okubajuliza mu ddwaliro eddene bwe kiba kyetaagisa, tekyabanga kyangu kugenda butereevu mu ddwaliro eddene nga balina obulwadde.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí tún ṣe àkíyèsi pé àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n mọ̀ pé àwọn ilé ìtọjú kéréje máa fi àwọn ránṣẹ́ sí ilé ìwòsàn tí ó bá nílò, máa ń sábà lọ sí ilé ìwòsàn fún ra wọn pẹ̀lú àìsàn wọn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baqaphelile ukuthi iziguli iziguli ebeziqonda ukuthi izikhungo zezempilo ezincane njenge mitholampilo ingabathumela esibhedlela uma kudingeka, ebemancane amathuba ukuthi bebengavele besuke beqonde ngqo esibhedlela ngenxa yokugula.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kuma lura cewa marasa lafiya da suka fahimci cewa ƙananan wurare kamar asibitoci na iya tura su asibiti idan an buƙata, ba za su iya zuwa asibiti kai-tsaye tare da matsalolin kiwon lafiya ba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši gape ba lemogile gore balwetši bao ba bego ba kwešiša gore mafelo a mannyane a go swana le kliniki a k aba romela sepetlele ge go hlokagala, go be go na le kgonagalo ye nnyane ya gore ba ya ka thwii sepetlele ge ba na le mathata a maphelo.
Amharic: እንደ ክሊኒኮች ያሉ ትንንሽ ተቋማት እንደ አስፈላጊነቱ ወደ ሆስፒታል ሊልኳቸው እንደሚችሉ የተረዱ ታካሚዎች ለጤና ጉዳዮች በቀጥታ ወደ ሆስፒታል የመሄዳቸው ሁኔታ አነስተኛ እንደሆነም ተመራማሪዎቹ አስተውለዋል፡፡

Source: The results of the study deepen scientific understanding of the healthcare system in Ethiopia.
Luganda: Ebyazuulibwa mu kunoonyereza byongera ku bugagga bw’okumanya kw’ekinassaayansi ku byobulamu mu ggwanga lya Ethiopia.
Yoruba: Èsì ìwádìí yìí jẹ́ kí òye sáyẹ́nsì nípa ètò ilé ìtọ́jú ní Ethiopia gbinlẹ̀ si.
Zulu: Imiphumela yalolu cwaningo ijulisa ukuqonda kwesayensi kohlelo lokunakekelwa kwezempilo e-Ethiopia.
Hausa: Sakamakon binciken ya zurfafa fahimtar kimiyya game da tsarin kiwon lafiya a Habasha.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tša dinyakišišo di tseneletša kwešišo ya tša mahlale ya tshepedišo ya tlhokomelo ya maphelo ka Ethiopia.

Source: They also suggest monitoring how, and when, patients are referred from smaller facilities to hospitals, and add that healthcare providers should educate their local community about referral practices.

Source: In the future, the researchers suggest that more information should be collected on the costs of self-referrals to both patients and the healthcare system.
